gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-noto-sans-nko: Shantell Sans draws every stroke with one fixed nib. Noto Sans NKo follows in a plain sans manner, its see-through c openings letting a long passage move along without a snag.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-tasa-explorer: Expressive and a little wild, Shantell Sans has a round bowl whose outline never swells or thins, which looks best large and brief. And TASA Explorer finishes its curves like brush strokes lifted early, so the heading's quirks have something friendly beside them.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ysabeau-office: Shantell Sans has curves that match its stems exactly, like a marker held at one angle. Ysabeau Office does the opposite job, leaving every curved letter open-ended so text can move along quickly.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-zalando-sans-sem: Distinctive from the first word, Shantell Sans looks drawn in neon tube. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded runs below it with open-mouthed curves, a plain sans that lets paragraphs unroll smoothly.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-: Shantell Sans brings a wide, loose, marker-like mouth to the headline, so larger sizes will show it off well. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique takes over below with a t whose crossbar and stem match in weight, and bends that stay smooth.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Wobbly, wide-mouthed and hand-inked, the heading hardly looks tame. Zen Maru Gothic stays a plain sans underneath, never snagging on a closed-up bowl, so reading feels like following a single thread.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-hind: Sniglet looks stout and blunt, its terminals stopping short of curling back in. Hind answers with lowercase nearly matching its capitals and a string-steady stroke, so the two sit together like a shout and a murmur.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-akatab: Commanding and cut like sign-shop vinyl, Sniglet holds one line width throughout. Akatab's round letters look cupped rather than clenched, so a plain sans body here feels approachable across a whole page.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-alef: Alef reads modern and clean, with open-ended curves throughout. Sniglet above it ends its terminals at the width they began, which gives a long passage underneath a firm, quiet lead-in.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Sniglet draws its strokes at one weight, blunt and quietly commanding. Alegreya Sans SC does the gentler work, with a welcoming gap in the c that lets text breathe.
